criteria.why: Shipment ID membership and frequencies distinguish two different questions even when numerical answers coincide.
criteria.naive: Repeated full scans O(nq), dense array alternative and sparse large signed ID range.
criteria.observation: One key per distinct ID; map values are associated information, not duplicate entries; default key ordering derived.
criteria.method: Count using bracket insertion, query using find without mutation; sorted report; redundant teaching set explicitly removable in real solution.
criteria.example: Six-step7,2,7,5,2,7 trace, absent9 query and exact sorted report.
criteria.proof: Prefix frequency induction, new/existing key branches, non-mutating queries and complete ordered traversal.
criteria.time: All operations bounded using log(d+2) including empty states; repeated at report logarithmic, direct map report linear; counts fit int.
criteria.implementation: Four exact explained fragments: types/state, input update, guarded find queries, ordered report; complete C++17 last.
criteria.boundaries: Empty log, repeated misses, zero/negative/extreme IDs, all-equal/distinct, no queries; end never dereferenced.
criteria.mistakes: Brackets insert absent keys; set loses duplicate tickets; multiset erase(value) versus one iterator; strict comparator.
criteria.connections: Lower/upper-bound meanings and begin/end guards; member versus generic lower_bound; unordered average/worst case and no ordered neighbours.
criteria.recognition: Dense arrays, static sorting, membership sets, keyed maps and unsupported rank/interval aggregates distinguished.
criteria.practice: Six existing tasks; all five old references preserved as appropriate optional progression; olympiad median/partition prerequisites explicit.
criteria.priority: High foundational usefulness; only direct distinct-count312 core, already live High and no metadata rewrite planned.
